integrity: Proof uses exhaustive exact integer cubical-chain computations, certified free-face collapses and a verified Smith reduction; its output can be replayed with standard-library Python. The first-homology formula is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only this graph and three unordered points. No full homotopy-type classification, equivariant structure, cohomology ring, or definitive priority claim; independent validation not performed.
title: Integral homology and a two-dimensional spine for three unordered points on the Petersen graph
